name: One-Pot Chicken Biryani

components.name: Chicken Biryani
steps: Rinse basmati thoroughly and soak for 20 minutes; drain just before cooking.
Coat chicken with all marinade ingredients. Refrigerate for at least 30 to 60 minutes.
Heat oil and ghee in a wide heavy pot; toast whole spices, then cook sliced onions until golden.
Add chilies and tomatoes; reduce the tomatoes briefly. Add marinated chicken, stir and cook until the outside loses its pink colour.
Stir in mint and coriander. Add soaked rice and measured water, taste the liquid and adjust only within salt allowance.
Bring to a boil, cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat until rice is done and chicken reaches 74°C. Rest 10 minutes off heat before fluffing.
Divide promptly into shallow containers, cool fast and refrigerate/freeze.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
A stovetop one-pot chicken biryani recipe; oven-baked Hadrian-reviewed biryani is a separate shortlisted recipe. Choose bone-in/boneless at recipe creation because nutrition differs.
Storing & reheating: Freeze rice and chicken rapidly after cooking in shallow portions.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.

Rice must be rapidly cooled and chilled; never leave cooked rice standing for extended periods.
